Rina Shah: Heads-up: ran into a subtle issue in the async Python quickstart. When a streaming upload times out and the SDK retries, the customer saw duplicate resources created. Repro and notes below.
Tom Alvarez: Oof. Is this the async generator -> consumed on first try problem?
Rina Shah: Exactly. Minimal repro from the sample: ```py
async def body():
    for i in range(3):
        yield b"chunk-%d" % i
await client.async_create(model_payload, stream=body(), timeout=2)
```
Keiko Yamamoto: Async generators are single-use; retries can't re-iterate. What did the logs show?
Rina Shah: Logs: ```
2026-11-03T22:11:02Z WARN req=aa11 status=504 read_timeout
2026-11-03T22:11:03Z INFO retrying req=aa11 attempt=2 backoff=0.6s
2026-11-03T22:11:04Z INFO request=req=bb22 status=201 created=asset-77
```
Tom Alvarez: So retry used a new request id (bb22) and server created a second resource. Was there an Idempotency-Key?
Rina Shah: No. Quickstart didn't show one. Also the async helper had no option to buffer or replay stream.
Keiko Yamamoto: Two orthogonal fixes: (1) make idempotency easier in quickstart & helpers; (2) let async helpers support replayable streams via an opt-in param.
Tom Alvarez: Agreed. Proposal: helper signature: `async_create(payload, *, idempotency_key: Optional[str]=None, auto_idempotency: bool=False, stream_replay: Literal["never","buffer_mem","spool_disk"]="never", timeout: float=5.0)` — keep defaults to avoid surprising behavior.
Keiko Yamamoto: Typing should be explicit in stubs: `from typing import Literal, Optional` so mypy catches misuse. Use `Literal` for `stream_replay`.
Rina Shah: For quickstarts, we'll show two variants: (A) explicit idempotency key: `idempotency_key=str(uuid.uuid4())` for demos, and (B) enable `auto_idempotency=True` in the highest-level snippet so new users don't accidentally double-create during flaky demos.
Tom Alvarez: Auto idempotency is convenient, but must be opt-in. Also log metadata `X-Idempotency-Auto: true` when applied, and emit a debug metric `sdk.idempotency.auto_applied`.
Keiko Yamamoto: For stream replay implementation: `buffer_mem` collects into BytesIO (good for small payloads), `spool_disk` writes to tempfile and re-reads on retry. All buffer modes are opt-in; add `max_buffer_bytes` config so users can limit memory.
Rina Shah: Tests: we need unit + ci integration tests: (1) async generator + `stream_replay='buffer_mem'` simulates 504 then 201 and asserts server saw single create when idempotency key present. (2) verify `never` + no idempotency reproduces duplicate create.
Tom Alvarez: Also clarify which error codes we retry by default in docs. Recommend treating 5xx (502/504) and client-side timeouts as uncertain and require idempotency for safe retries. Show `decorrelated_jitter` backoff example and `max_retries=3` in quickstart.
Keiko Yamamoto: Add a troubleshooting blurb: "If duplicates appear after async retries: check for missing Idempotency-Key; if streaming, either buffer for replay or avoid automatic retries; consider enabling auto_idempotency for demo flows."
CI-bot: CI run 2187654340: sample-async-quickstart integration failed (1 test)  reproduced duplicate-create scenario without idempotency and stream_replay=never.
Rina Shah: CI repro is perfect. I'll open a quick docs PR to update quickstart and onboarding notes. Tom, can you draft the SDK change & types? Keiko, can you add the async buffering impl and tests?
Tom Alvarez: I'll sketch the PR today. Plan: add new params to helper stubs, default behavior unchanged, include changelog entry for minor release, and tests that validate header injection and metric emission.
Keiko Yamamoto: I'll implement `spool_disk` using tempfile.SpooledTemporaryFile and emit metrics `stream_replay.spooled=true/false`. Also add a sample showing how to convert a generator to a bytes object when replay is undesired.
Rina Shah: Great. Targeting a small patch to quickstart by EOD so demos don't break tomorrow.
Tom Alvarez: +1. Also add an explicit example for sync vs async parity so both SDKs show the same idempotency guidance.
Keiko Yamamoto: Will add that to the docs PR.
